events.description: Joey Tribbiani says the remark said to Monica Geller was a pickup line.
Monica Geller asks why anybody would use a pickup line on Monica Geller.

Ross Geller says Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, and Monica Geller are looking for an explanation more sophisticated than the idea that Monica Geller's date wanted to get Monica Geller into bed.
Ross Geller says Monica Geller's date was trying to get Monica Geller into bed.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller hates men.
Phoebe Buffay tells Monica Geller to stop hating.
Phoebe Buffay says Monica Geller does not want to put hate out into the universe.
Monica Geller wonders if Monica Geller has some sort of beacon that only dogs and men with severe emotional problems can hear.
Phoebe Buffay tells Monica Geller to come over.
Phoebe Buffay tells Monica Geller to give Phoebe Buffay Monica Geller's feet.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller thought Monica Geller's date was nice.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani cannot believe Monica Geller did not know the remark said to Monica Geller was a pickup line.
Rachel Green asks the group to guess what Rachel Green is about to say.
Ross Geller asks whether Rachel Green got a job.
Rachel Green asks if Ross Geller is kidding.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is trained for nothing.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green was laughed out of twelve interviews today.
Chandler Bing says Rachel Green is surprisingly upbeat.
Rachel Green says Chandler Bing would also be upbeat.
Rachel Green says Chandler Bing would be upbeat if Chandler Bing found John and David boots on sale at fifty percent off.
Chandler Bing says Rachel Green knows Chandler Bing well.
Rachel Green says the boots are Rachel Green's new 'I don't need a job, I don't need my parents, I've got great boots' boots.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green does not need a job.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green does not need Rachel Green's parents.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green has great boots.
Monica Geller asks how Rachel Green paid for the boots.
Monica Geller asks who pays the credit card bill for the boots.
